# raff_ip (Resource)

Reserves a Raff floating IP. The IP is held for the project until the resource is destroyed.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `billing_period` (String) Subscription billing period. Ignored for PAYG accounts.
- `region` (String) Region for the reserved IP. Defaults to the project's default region.
- `type` (String) IP family to reserve (ipv4 or ipv6). Defaults to ipv4.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip_address` (String) The reserved IP address.
- `project_id` (String)
- `reserved` (Boolean)
- `status` (String) Whether the IP is free or in-use.
- `updated_at` (String)
